lines: What if your feed actually taught you something?
Type any question. Like, how do planes stay in the air?
Unspool looks it up, and writes the explanation.
Then turns it into short reels. One idea each.
The four forces. How a wing lifts. Why planes stall.
And a quiz, so it actually sticks.
Black holes. The stock market. Why the sky is blue. Type it in, and scroll.
